knowledge_cards.summary: Non-bossing high-density farmer (Simulacrum/Ritual/Ultimatum/Harvest/Strongbox/Abyss); low input, walk-away-able but not literally AFK; weak at bosses (no Maven); farm currency + Mageblood then reroll.
knowledge_cards.coach_use: Set expectations: recommend for density farming, not bossing.
Gate CWS swap advice on L87+.

knowledge_cards.summary: Bloodnotch nerf hurts early (~8 points to mitigate); by endgame Defiance of Destiny removes the impact.
Keep Lori's Lantern in small arenas; swap to The Hateful Accuser for single target (trialmaster/map boss).
Hideout RF tooltip 400k is the Simulacrum first-stable benchmark (3.26 handbook's 250k is a lower legacy comfort bar).
Defiance of Destiny effectively cancels the Bloodnotch nerf and is the core tank upgrade.

DD imbue priority: Cruelty > Swift Affliction > Deadly Ailments > Lifetap(?) > Burning Damage > Sadism > Efficacy > Unbound Ailments. Unearth imbue is weak; needs L21 for even thresholds (28=29, 30=31...).

guardrails: Brine King, stun immunity, and Vaal Breach can turn off the Bloodnotch/CWS loop; warn separately.
No Bloodnotch is a gateway only; guide recommends L87+ swap.
Drop Life Recoup over 3 seconds mastery after Bloodnotch.
Vaal Breach risks disabling Bloodnotch before Defiance of Destiny.
The Hateful Accuser is curse-based: curse-immune / reduced-curse maps are fatal.
Maven-class bosses are out of scope for this build.
Many PoBs exist, but 3.29 survivability, price, and SSF reproducibility are unproven.
CWS is not a beginner default; it is an internal-bar build and practice candidate.
